title: Spanish exceeds 600 million speakers worldwide for the first time
text:
Spanish exceeds 600 million speakers worldwide for the first time

## The Instituto Cervantes Yearbook 2024 reveals that Spanish is consolidating worldwide on platforms such as Netflix or Spotify and in the consumption of video games

 Eduardo González 31 de October de 2024 in Frontpage, Suscriptores, The world in Spain 

Luis García Montero during the presentation of the Yearbook. / Photo: IC
